title: Clark–Ismail positivity conjecture for the functions $f_j$ and $g_j$
statement:
Let $j>1$ and $v>0$. Define

$$
f_j(v)=\frac{\operatorname{d}^j}{\operatorname{d}v^j}\left(\frac{v^j}{1-\operatorname{e}^{-v}}\right),
$$

and

$$
g_j(v)=\left(\frac{1-\operatorname{e}^{-v}}{v}\right)^{j+1}\operatorname{e}^{jv}f_j(v).
$$

**Clark–Ismail's positivity conjecture.** The functions $f_j(v)$, or equivalently $g_j(v)$, are positive on $(0,\infty)$ for all $j>1$. This conjecture concerns the positivity needed to establish complete monotonicity of the associated derivatives of polygamma functions; it was posed by Clark and Ismail after verifying the claim computationally for $2\le j\le16$, and its general status is not specified in the source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.12697

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2023).
source_name: Yan-Fang Li, Dongkyu Lim and Feng Qi, “Closed-form formulas, determinantal expressions, recursive relations, power series, and special values of several functions used in Clark–Ismail's two conjectures”, arXiv:2310.12697 (2023).
